verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a personal AI agent; the evidence even contrasts Muse with OpenClaw, a self-set-up alternative. Nothing in the pack shows Muse can be self-hosted. Muse runs as a Meta-operated service reached through its mobile app, Mac app or WhatsApp, and its 'own computer' is a provider-managed VM. Being able to download VM files is data export, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
